quests.name: Clay Shards
text: Adam holds the [**Clay Shards**](gk2://item/clay_shards) artifact. To get it from him he asks you to do 2 things for him.

First he'll ask you to upgrade your Tavern to 40 quality, which requires 30 [**Wooden plank**](gk2://item/wooden_plank), 30 [**A piece of stone**](gk2://item/a_piece_of_stone) and 12 [**Simple iron parts**](gk2://item/simple_iron_parts) for an upgrade. You'll need to add 2 tables (8 [**Wooden plank**](gk2://item/wooden_plank) and 8 [**Nails**](gk2://item/nails) each) to the new spots that become available as well as have all previous artifacts on display to reach 40 tavern quality.

Secondly he'll ask you to help him with voices that bully him at night that leave no footprints. To deal with this return to his house after midnight and find [**Yorick**](gk2://character/yorick) outside. After a chat [**Yorick**](gk2://character/yorick) agrees to leave Adam alone. Return in the morning and talk to Adam to receive the [**Clay Shards**](gk2://item/clay_shards) and +20 ♥ with Adam.

quests.name: Ancient Keys
text: Adam has the [**Ancient Keys**](gk2://item/ancient_keys) in his house. Before you can enter his house you need to show him your interest in art and bring him 3 [**Porcelain pitcher**](gk2://item/porcelain_pitcher). He won't be impressed and will offer you 5 silver or you can choose to keep your [**Porcelain pitcher**](gk2://item/porcelain_pitcher). Next you can talk to the [**Merchant**](gk2://character/merchant) to obtain 3 rare vases but he's sold them already to the [**Beekeeper**](gk2://character/beekeeper). The [**Beekeeper**](gk2://character/beekeeper) seems to believe Adam is his arch nemesis and you conspire to fill the vases with poison which was stolen from the [**Beekeeper**](gk2://character/beekeeper) by [**Dig**](gk2://character/dig). Talk to [**Dig**](gk2://character/dig) and answer anything to his riddle to get the right "Poison Cake" answer. Take the **Cake with bee poison** to the [**Beekeeper**](gk2://character/beekeeper) to receive the **Vases of poison** to bring to Adam. This will gain you another +20 ♥ with him allowing you to enter his home and grab the [**Ancient Keys**](gk2://item/ancient_keys) from his chest by his bed. The chest also contains 3 [**Porcelain pitcher**](gk2://item/porcelain_pitcher), 5 [**Ceramic jug**](gk2://item/ceramic_jug), 3 [**Red jelly**](gk2://item/red_jelly), [**Beet slices**](gk2://item/beet_slices), 2 [**Bottle of berry juice**](gk2://item/bottle_of_berry_juice), 20 [**Ceramic bowls**](gk2://item/ceramic_bowls) and a [**Rusty hammer**](gk2://item/rusty_hammer).

quests.name: Supply him with Blood
text: Alaric is weak because of starvation. He asks you for a drop of [**Blood**](gk2://item/blood) or [**Bucket of blood**](gk2://item/bucket_of_blood). After delivering he will reward you with [**Sun cream for vampires**](gk2://item/sun_cream_for_vampires) as a reward. This can be shown to [**Horadric**](gk2://character/horadric) to make him believe you took care of the vampire and to end the vampire quest line.
He also points out to use the [**Witchers eye**](gk2://item/witcher_s_eye) to find the vampires that turned him into one.

After his quest, supplying him with [**Bucket of blood**](gk2://item/bucket_of_blood) will get you a [**Scroll of Teleportation**](gk2://item/scroll_of_teleportation). Or 25 cobre for every [**Blood**](gk2://item/blood).

quests.name: Bring him a Skull
text: Before you can talk to the astrologer you have to talk to Gerry and ask him about the astrologer.

Upon first meeting you he will ask you to retrieve a [**Skull**](gk2://item/skull) from a [**corpse**](gk2://item/corpse). Only after you return and give him a [**Skull**](gk2://item/skull) he will trade with you, if you ask him for help. You earn 10 ♥ for the skull.

quests.name: The Keepers Journal
text: After asking for help to open the portal in order to get home, he will request you to retrieve the previous [**keepers journal**](gk2://item/keepers_journal) and will give you the [**keepers key**](gk2://item/keepers_key) which is meant to be able to unlock the gate below the church though he does not know how to use it. For the information on how to use the [**keepers key**](gk2://item/keepers_key), you first need to talk with [**Snake**](gk2://character/snake) about it and then study it on the [**study table**](gk2://item/study_table). After you opened the gate you will have access to the [**keepers journal**](gk2://item/keepers_journal).

quests.name: Clean the Journal
text: After handing over the [**Keepers journal**](gk2://item/keepers_journal) he tells you to visit the town to acquire the parts for building a laser to open the portal on Witch Hill. He also tells you that part of the [**Keepers journal**](gk2://item/keepers_journal) is covered in goo(?) and he needs some [**acid**](gk2://item/acid) to clean it, which can be acquired from [**Clotho**](gk2://character/clotho). Alternatively you can craft it in the [**alchemy workbench (tier II)**](gk2://item/alchemy_workbench_tier_ii). For more information see alchemy.

After you brought the acid, he tells you, that you'll need **Restoration tools** for the second part. You can get those from [**Snake**](gk2://character/snake). Bring them to him and earn another 10 ♥.

quests.name: The Necronomicon
text: [**Snake**](gk2://character/snake) tells you to ask the astrologer about the [**Necronomicon**](gk2://item/necronomicon). If you do so, he tells you that he gave it to the [**Lighthouse Keeper**](gk2://character/lighthouse_keeper).

quests.name: Long-lost Daughter
text: Once you acquire the items to clean the journal and bring them to the astrologer, he discovers in the diary that he might have a long-lost daughter (and the info you needed as well). He wants you to get information about his family in exchange for what you want to know. He tells you that the [**Gypsy Baron**](gk2://character/gypsy_baron) is Esmeralda's (the mother) brother, and wants you to go and ask inquire about her. You can find the Baron at the camp, north-west of the lighthouse.

quests.name: Messenger
text: After doing the [**Gypsy Baron**](gk2://character/gypsy_baron) a favour, he tells you of Esmeralda and her child's fate. The astrologer gets emotional when you tell him about Esmeralda's fate and that her daughter is alive and well. You earn another 10 ♥ by that. He gives you another task before giving you the information you need: You are to speak to [**Ms. Charm**](gk2://character/ms_charm) and find out if she knows about her father.

quests.name: Heart-breaking News
text: [**Ms. Charm**](gk2://character/ms_charm) makes very clear to you that she despises her father, whoever he might be, and that she doesn't want to know of him or his identity at all. The astrologer takes the news with a heavy heart, but insists that there must be a way to gain her forgiveness. You tell him you'll let him know if you get any news. You'll earn 10 ♥ from this conversation.

quests.name: Mill Repair
text: In order to fix the mill, you need a [**Paper with calculations**](gk2://item/paper_with_calculations) from him. You need 60 ♥ to be able to ask - and you will be given. Bring it back to the [**miller**](gk2://character/miller) and fix the mill.

quests.name: The Golden Angle
text: You should have 60 ♥ with him now, so you can finally ask about the three parts of the barrel. The astrologer tells you he had one of the required items (the [**golden angle**](gk2://item/golden_angle)) in a sealed University bag, but he abandoned it the day of the Great Blast around the war camp. He believes nobody would dare break the University seal and suggests you go look for it.
He also tells you that the [**necklace**](gk2://item/necklace) was in Esmeralda's posession and inherited by her daughter [**Ms. Charm**](gk2://character/ms_charm).

quests.name: Helping Vagner
text: [**Ms. Charm**](gk2://character/ms_charm) asks you to help [**Vagner**](gk2://character/vagner). Since you don't have an access to the Fort, you decide to seek the assistance of astrologer and earn 10 ♥ by that. He gladly agrees to help, hoping that this act would grant him forgiveness on part of his estranged daughter. But getting inside the Fort is not an easy task. The astrologer, however, has a plan - you all could get inside to 'continue' the archaeological dig, that was started years ago but never finished. In order to do that, though, he needs your help in repairing his reputation in the University.

quests.name: Silver Book or Research Obsidian
text: In order to restore old astrologer's reputation you need to bring him a (plata) [**Book**](gk2://item/book) (plata) for 5 ♥. After that you will have to wait a week, until he returns with the news.

Alternatively, if you own the Stranger Sins DLC, you can bring him the Research Obsidian - just note that this will void the achievement / trophy "Best Seller" as it skips the step where you give him a gold-quality Book.

quests.name: Gold Book
text: It turns out your book was a breath of fresh air for the bored eggheads in the University. So much so, that now they demand more! So, naturally, it's up to you to give them one. Bring a (oro) [**Book**](gk2://item/book) (oro) for 5 ♥, and - again - wait a week for the results.

quests.name: Bring Aristocrat Papers
text: With these amazing books, the astrologer was not only successful in organizing the new expedition - he was even reinstated as a professor. Not that it matters to him (or you, for that matter). But now almost everything is ready for the new expedition. All that's left is the access to the Fort. And for that [**Aristocrat papers**](gk2://item/aristocrat_papers) are needed. Bring them to the astrologer for 10 ♥, and as soon as it's done, you can start final part of his (and connected [**Ms. Charm's**](gk2://character/ms_charm)) quest.

quests.name: Expedition
text: Now, the rescue mission for [**Vagner**](gk2://character/vagner) can take place. You see a long cutscene, which explains the relationship between [**Ms. Charm**](gk2://character/ms_charm), [**Vagner**](gk2://character/vagner), the astrologer and the Lord Commander of the Mountain Fort.

All ends well, and you will get both [**necklace**](gk2://item/necklace) and [**Golden angle**](gk2://item/golden_angle) - two more items to return back home. You'll end up with 100 ♥ with both, [**Ms. Charm**](gk2://character/ms_charm) and the astrologer.

friendship.text: You need 60 ♥ to be able to ask - and you will be given.

quests.name: Fix the Graveyard
text: Upon arriving at the graveyard for the first time he will acknowledge you as the new graveyard keeper. He asks you to improve the graveyard to 5 de valoración del cementerio, and after doing so he will give you the Preacher Perk allowing you to hold sermons in the local church and gaining access to the alchemy lab and the [**study table**](gk2://item/study_table) in the cellars. You'll earn 10 ♥ from this.

Note that when you open the church, it counts as your prayer for the day. You will not be able to choose a prayer to get faith or donations for the service. After the ceremony, the Bishop disappears from his usual post next to the church for the remainder of the day.

quests.name: Bowls for the Soup Kitchen
text: Bishop needs 20 × [**Ceramic bowls**](gk2://item/ceramic_bowls) to serve soup at his Soup Kitchen near the Church. He gives you access to "The Concept of Dirt" technology which lets you gather [**sand**](gk2://item/river_sand) and [**clay**](gk2://item/clay). To make his bowls you'll need to get [**clay**](gk2://item/clay) from digging at any of the craggy holes around the map (one is directly south of the graveyard), and then use it with water at the potter's wheel. You'll earn 10 ♥ from bringing the bowls and the "Cleric's Beginner's Guide" worth blue.

quests.name: Improve the Graveyard
text: To expand the church he requests you to get the graveyard to 30 de valoración del cementerio. You receive 5 ♥ for completing the quest.

quests.name: Improve the Church
text: Furthermore, he requests you to get the church to 20 de valoración de la iglesia. By using [**candle**](gk2://item/candle)s in the candelabra I or candelabra II, you can increase the score temporarily and finish the task without having to build an expensive interior. You receive 5 ♥ for completing the quest.

quests.name: Bring Quality Fish Fillets
text: The Bishop would like some freshly caught 4 × [**Quality fish fillet**](gk2://item/quality_fish_fillet) (bronce) (Must be (bronce)) because he can't eat meat. [**Bream**](gk2://item/bream) is catchable with a 100% rate at the river far north of the church (you need to unblock the path) without bait. You can also catch it at the waterfall fishing spot which is across the stone bridge west of the graveyard and directly north using [**Maggot**](gk2://item/maggot) as bait. You can also purchase them from the lighthouse. The fillet itself is prepared in your kitchen. You receive 10 ♥ for completing the quest.

quests.name: Bring a Building Permission
text: After delivering 4 × [**Quality fish fillet**](gk2://item/quality_fish_fillet) (bronce) the bishop will complain about bureaucracy. You have to bring him a [**Building permission**](gk2://item/building_permission) (it costs 20 plata) to transform the church into a big church. Bear in mind though, after the upgrade, you won't be able to do any church services until you become a rightful citizen, that's another 3 plata.

quests.name: Improve the Church further
text: He wants you now to improve the church once more, this time to 50 de valoración de la iglesia though!

quests.name: Improve the Graveyard further
text: As before, but now he wants you to increase your graveyard to 200 de valoración del cementerio.

quests.name: Gold Quality Marble Statues
text: After your graveyard reaches 100 de valoración del cementerio, he admires your graveyard and suddenly realizes he needs 3 × [**A carved piece of marble**](gk2://item/a_carved_piece_of_marble) (oro) of himself! Three of (oro) quality, to be exact. Hand those over for 10 ♥. You should now have 70 ♥ and could ask to upgrade your church to a cathedral.

Please note, your chances to get[**A carved piece of marble**](gk2://item/a_carved_piece_of_marble) (oro) of (oro) quality increases to 80% percent once you have unlocked the tricks of the trade perk from the tech tree.
(No longer required to preach - potential temporary Bug?)

quests.name: Bring Aristocrat Papers
text: After upgrading to the cathedral, speak to the bishop and he will tell you he needs [**aristocrat papers**](gk2://item/aristocrat_papers).

You can become an aristocrat via the royal services in front of the church for 12 oro. You then get the papers for free. Show them to the bishop for another 10 ♥. (No longer required - potential Bug?)

quests.name: Bring an Accepted Invitation
text: After upgrading to the cathedral, the Bishop also demands an [**Accepted invitation**](gk2://item/accepted_invitation) from you.

Speak to the [**Inquisitor**](gk2://character/inquisitor) about the papers, but he will turn you down. You will need to get the invitation from the [**merchant**](gk2://character/merchant) instead. This can only be done once you have reached 90 ♥ with the [**merchant**](gk2://character/merchant). Turn in the invitation for another 10 ♥.

quests.name: Hold the Ceremony
text: Once you have turned in both required papers, you should have acquired 90 ♥ with the Bishop and will be able to hold the ceremony.

Speak with the Bishop again to finish his quest line. You see a cutscene, where the two brothers reunite and earn the achievement "Two Brothers". You will receive the [**Mirror of pride**](gk2://item/mirror_of_pride) from the Bishop and the [**Salty fork**](gk2://item/salty_fork) from the [**merchant**](gk2://character/merchant).

Note that when you hold the ceremony, it counts as your prayer for the day (at least if you hold the ceremony before doing a prayer). You will not be able to choose a prayer to get faith or donations for the service. After the ceremony, the Bishop disappears from his usual post next to the church for the remainder of the day.

quests.name: Lost Memories
text: Upon first meeting you she will tell you that she has lost her mind. She gives you a quest to help restore her mind. She asks you to either bring her [**heal potion**](gk2://item/heal_potion) which gives you 20 ♥ or bring her the ingredients: [**cauldron**](gk2://item/cauldron) from the [**blacksmith**](gk2://character/krezvold) for 10 plata, [**bee**](gk2://item/bee) and [**life powder**](gk2://item/life_powder) for a total of also 20 ♥ and 3 × [**heal potion**](gk2://item/heal_potion).
She unlocks the alchemy tech tree for you when you accept this mission, making various alchemy-related structures available for construction in the alchemy lab.

quests.name: The Merchant's Cure
text: The [**merchant**](gk2://character/merchant) asks you to speak to Clotho for a cure for his curse after consuming the [**hiccup grass**](gk2://item/hiccup_grass). Clotho tells you the recipe for her cure: [**salt**](gk2://item/salt) and [**health solution**](gk2://item/health_solution). Completing the quest will unlock the [**Spices**](gk2://item/spices) recipe. As with all recipes, you can produce spices without having them unlocked by this quest, simply by trying it out or looking it up in this wiki.

quests.name: Pumpkin Soup
text: In order to start this quest, you must unlock the orchard. If you give her a [**Pumpkin**](gk2://item/pumpkin) (plata) (has to be (plata)), she'll give you the recipes for various soups.

quests.name: Basket of food
text: [**Miss Chain**](gk2://character/miss_chain) bids you, to deliver a [**basket of food**](gk2://item/basket_of_food) to her sister. When you do so, you won't earn anything from it, but you've got the opportunity, to buy 10 × [**frog**](gk2://item/frog) from her, you need also (12) for [**Miss Chain's**](gk2://character/miss_chain) quest. For some reason, gaining a frog by purchasing it from Clotho does not unlock the recipe to make raw sliced meat from 3x frog. Rather, that recipe must be unlocked by using fishing to get a frog.

quests.name: Enchanted pumpkin
text: During a mission from Game of Crone, you will require a gold quality pumpkin to enchant (plus 50 silver), that you'll need to bring to Clotho.

quests.name: Encargos
text: She first asks you to build a kitchen at the camp, so that she does not get bored and sad. This quest unlocks the ability to trade with her, but **only** the first two tiers are unlocked.
The next assignment is to improve the kitchen, so it feels more like home to her. With it, you gain the ability to build kitchen II.

After you built the kitchen II and spoke with her about it, she'll ask you to construct [**Beehive**](gk2://item/bee_hive)s to sweeten the taste of the foods. (Only need to build 2 of the 3 to complete the quest) After finishing this quest, she gives you 3 recipes (**Recipe In Lentil We Trust**, **Recipe Vegetable set**, [**Honey cake**](gk2://item/honey_cake)) and unlocks the tier III trade option.

quests.name: Encargos
text: Cory and [**Tress**](gk2://character/tress) need to help you build your Tavern after buying the land from [**Horadric**](gk2://character/horadric) for 30 plata. Speaking to Cory he will tell you they need to build a barn first. You can choose to either pay him (2 oro) or supply him the materials (12 [**Simple iron parts**](gk2://item/simple_iron_parts), 12 [**Wooden plank**](gk2://item/wooden_plank), 12 [**Nails**](gk2://item/nails) and 50 plata) to finish working on the barn and get to building your Tavern. Go to sleep to let the brothers finish the Tavern for you. You'll receive the Talking Skull achievement.

quests.name: Cake recipe
text: Upon first meeting you he will ask you to bring him 5 × [**Honey**](gk2://item/honey). (There are two trees with honey just above a hill in the north-west direction from your house.) He will teach you the cake recipe after doing that.

quests.name: Carrots and Oil
text: After you re-open the Church, the Donkey sees that you are not his comrade and instead have become a capitalist. He goes on strike and demands that you bring him 10 × [**carrot**](gk2://item/carrot) and [**seed oil**](gk2://item/seed_oil) to grease the cart's wheels before he will complete the delivery of his current corpse. He notifies you that he will only bring future corpses for the price of 5 × [**carrot**](gk2://item/carrot), paid in advance. You can pay these carrots by storing 10 at a time in a box nearby the Morgue. He also tells you that he wants a day off and will no longer bring corpses on Orgullo.

quests.name: Revolution
text: Become an ally of Comrade Donkey and take part in the Revolution!

The first day after Donkey's strike, he will come inform you of the revolutionary plans of the ECoPoDP (The Executive Committee of the Party of the Donkeys' Proletariat). He wants you to build a contraband box, create a [**Cookbook**](gk2://item/cookbook) (crafted at the Desk), and provide 5 × [**red apple**](gk2://item/red_apple). The contraband box can be assembled right next to the Donkey's usual drop-off spot, no parts needed.
The reward for providing these items is [**jewelry**](gk2://item/jewelry) and [**Bank checks**](gk2://item/bank_checks) and the Revolutionary message 1
The Revolutionary message 1 the Donkey gives you, asks for 5 × **faith** and [**Aphorisms about the evils of money**](gk2://item/aphorisms_about_the_evils_of_money) (crafted at the Desk).

Go to bed when that's done and you'll find the in the Contraband Box the Revolutionary message 2 and 2 × [**Pile of components**](gk2://item/pile_of_components), which you will need to craft the Donkey Combat Equipment which is a [**Battle horseshoes**](gk2://item/battle_horseshoes) and [**Iron unicorn horns**](gk2://item/iron_unicorn_horns). You'll also have to bring a [**Pumpkin**](gk2://item/pumpkin) (oro) to [**Clotho**](gk2://character/clotho) and have her enchant it. She'll do it for the modest sum of 50 plata. For the Donkey Combat Equipment, you will need to take the 2 × [**Pile of components**](gk2://item/pile_of_components) to [**Krezvold**](gk2://character/krezvold) and give him 50 plata. Wait for the next day, collect the [**Battle horseshoes**](gk2://item/battle_horseshoes) and [**Iron unicorn horns**](gk2://item/iron_unicorn_horns) and send it through the Contraband Box.

The day after you will find in the box only the Revolutionary message 3 with a request to deliver 2 × [**Black paint**](gk2://item/black_paint), 2 × [**White paint**](gk2://item/white_paint), 5 × [**Jelly of incredible power**](gk2://item/jelly_of_incredible_power) and a [**Revolutionary donkey banner**](gk2://item/revolutionary_donkey_banner)
Once all these items will be delivered the [**Donkey**](gk2://character/donkey) will inform you that the Revolution is over and reward you with an [**Ice axe**](gk2://item/ice_axe)

quests.name: Repairs
text: You have to repair all the furniture in Euric's Room. You'll also have to repair the equipment in the Souls room to proceed. Note that when building and repairing objects in the Souls room, the counter will increase.

quests.name: Soul healing
text: Use the Soul extractor to extract a soul from a corpse, and you'll get a [**Harmed soul**](gk2://item/harmed_soul). Place it in the Soul healer and assign the selected organ(s). As a result, you will have a Healed soul, which can in turn be placed into the Soul portal, granting soul. You can hold these up to the limit of your .

Note: While souls from corpses can be healed as soon as the repair is done, in order to progress with the story-quests, you need to upgrade the Souls Healer with the Human Souls Repair - a chair for Euric to sit on. This is available only in the room's build menu.
Speak with Euric, and he'll say he needs charged shards of sin.

quests.name: Deadly sins
text: First up is Pride - it could only be the [**Bishop**](gk2://character/bishop). You need an [**Ode**](gk2://item/ode_for_bishop) about how cool he is. When you have the Ode, you'll also need one [**shard of sin**](gk2://item/sin_shard) which will become a charged shard.
Speak to Euric for a healing session. Wait one day before talking to him again.
The next two can be done in any order.

Gluttony is the merchant. Go to Clotho to ask for the recipe for the sauce. Make it in the church workbench with 1x Seed Oil, 2x Egg, 1x Salt. Give to Merchant along with 1x Sin Shard which will become a charged shard.
Wrath is the Inquisitor. Give Clotho 2x Honey Jar to get the witches ashes. Give to Inquisitor along with 1x Sin Shard which will become a charged shard.
Speak to Euric for a healing session. Wait one day before talking to him again.
The next three can be done in any order.
Euric will have given you a note for Snake. Speak to him with the note in your inventory and with 1x Sin Shard in your inventory. You'll get a charged shard.
Also speak to Stargazer and Ms. Charm while having 1x Sin Shard in your inventory for each. You'll get a charged shard for each.

quests.name: Repairs
text: Here is a list of the items needed to fix everything:
• Krezvold: 2 Planks, 4 Nails, 1 Wood repair kit
• Horadiric: 2 Flitch, 5 Nails, 2 Complex iron parts
• Basket eggs: 2 Sticks, 1 Wood repair kit
• 2 beehives: 2 Flitch, 3 Nails, 5 Bees each
• Adam's pottery wheel: 2 Flitch, 1 Stone, 3 Nails
• Thorn washcloth: 2 Sticks, 2 Rope
• Rosa's cow: 4 Ash
• Farmer's light: 2 Stones, 2 Simple iron parts, 1 Glass
Here are the totals:
• Planks 2
• Nails 18
• Flitch 6
• Sticks 4
• Stone 3
• Rope 2
• Ash 4
• Simple iron parts 2
• Complex iron parts 2
• Wood repair kit 2
• Bees 10
• Glass 1

quests.name: Let Alisa go
text: [**Ms. Charm**](gk2://character/ms_charm) wants Alisa, the farmer's daughter, to accompany her to the King's palace in town. When the farmer first says no, his [**son**](gk2://character/farmer_s_son) bids you to fix the mill of his [**uncle**](gk2://character/miller) for this. After having done so, you return to the farmer for 10 ♥ and Alisa's Paper.

quests.name: The Legionary Helm
text: Asked by [**Gerry**](gk2://character/gerry) to get the Legionary Helm from the Farmer's house. The Farmer will scoff and tell you to impress him by bringing him a carrot as big as a log!

You ask for [**Clotho's**](gk2://character/clotho) help, and after flirting with you, she agrees on the condition you get her a date with [**Cory**](gk2://character/cory) (the Stonemason, in the NW corner of the village).

Cory is not interested, so you'll ask his brother [**Tress**](gk2://character/tress) (the Carpenter, straight East of Cory) who will tell you his brother can't resist a lucrative business deal! Return to Cory and offer to introduce him to a supplier who can produce exclusive magical potions (i.e. Clotho). Cory jumps at the opportunity!

Return to Clotho (**don't forget to bring her a carrot**) and tell her the good news. She'll magic your carrot into a log-sized vegetable you can carry back to the farmer as though it were a log. The Farmer is impressed and agrees to let you into his house. You gain 20 ♥.

This should bring you to a total of 30 ♥ with the Farmer (assuming you've done the Let Alisa Go quest already). HOWEVER! Access to the house requires 40 ♥ ! While this may seem like a bug, it's not quite.

Go home and sleep in a bed. When you wake, the Farmer is at your door, expressing his gratitude to you for keeping his son's dirty secret (the wine flask quest you did earlier). While his family values are questionable, he's nonetheless impressed enough to raise his another 20, which should now total up to 50 ♥ .

You may get another blocking message saying "It's wrong to break into people's houses at night" (even thought it is clearly daytime). Wait another day, until the farmer exits his house in the late morning, then enter the house, find the helmet in a chest beside the bed, and take it back to [**Gerry**](gk2://character/gerry). The chest also contains {{cols|3|
• 2 × [**Baked pumpkin**](gk2://item/baked_pumpkin) (plata)
• [**Vegetable soup**](gk2://item/vegetable_soup) (plata)
• 3 × [**Pumpkin soup**](gk2://item/pumpkin_soup) (plata)
• 6 × [**Boost fertilizer II**](gk2://item/boost_fertilizer_ii)
• 4 × [**Quality fertilizer II**](gk2://item/quality_fertilizer_ii)
• 12 × [**Lentils**](gk2://item/lentils) (plata)
• 8 × [**Pumpkin**](gk2://item/pumpkin) (bronce)
• 10 × [**Onion seed**](gk2://item/onion_seed) (plata)
• 14 × [**Carrot seed**](gk2://item/carrot_seed)

quests.name: Get Gerry Beer
text: Gerry asks for beer which requires you to find [**Horadric**](gk2://character/horadric) in the village at The Dead Horse tavern. You can use the[**A mug of beer**](gk2://item/a_mug_of_beer) (bronce) you earned as a reward for delivering the letter to [**Krezvold**](gk2://character/krezvold) or purchase one from the tavern (must be (bronce)).
20 ♥ enables dialogue with Gerry, telling the player how to get to the library and about the [**Astrologer**](gk2://character/astrologer).

quests.name: Gunter
text: After the fourth Gula (19.5 days) and reaching 20 ♥ with Gerry, return to the morgue. In a cutscene, Gerry will tell you about a [**zombie**](gk2://item/zombie) chained in the northern part of the church cellar.
Visit the [**Gunter**](gk2://character/gunter) page for more.

quests.name: Get Gerry Wine
text: Gerry still isn't drunk and decides to make it your problem. He wants [**red wine**](gk2://item/red_wine) (plata). You can make it yourself or purchase some from [**Horadric**](gk2://character/horadric) (must be (plata)). Gerry tells you that the [**Astrologer**](gk2://character/astrologer) had the best wine, but he doesn't sell it.

quests.name: Get Gerry Cognac
text: [**Wine**](gk2://item/red_wine) isn't strong enough for Gerry, who asks you to find him cognac instead. Whenever you speak to him again he will have remembered where he and an old keeper buried some cognac. Several interactable mounds spawn between The Village and the Lighthouse. These look like grass with rocks around them and only spawn after this dialogue.

After digging up the one north of [**Dig**](gk2://character/dig), a cutscene will play where Gerry tells you about what you've found. [**Krezvold**](gk2://character/krezvold) interrupts to tell you that you can't dig in the Village unless you're a landowner.

quests.name: The Talking Skull
text: Return to the morgue and speak with Gerry. He will tell you his plan to buy land to open a tavern as a front for digging out the cellar and using the machine. You must speak with [**Horadric**](gk2://character/horadric) in the tavern and ask to purchase land. Speak to [**Dig**](gk2://character/dig) and then return to Horadric and ask to purchase land in Dig's name; this will cost 30 plata. Horadric will tell you that [**Cory**](gk2://character/cory) and [**Tress**](gk2://character/tress) can help you, but you can only speak to Corey about building the tavern.

You have two options: Pay them 2 oro to finish the barn and build the tavern. Or give them: 12 × [**simple iron parts**](gk2://item/simple_iron_parts), 12 × [**Wooden plank**](gk2://item/wooden_plank), and 12 × [**nails**](gk2://item/nails) for the barn, and pay 50 plata to build The Talking Skull. If you pay them 2 oro, despite saying the tavern will be ready by dawn, it will when you next sleep. If you provided materials, they will finish the barn the next day and ask for 50 plata. The next time you sleep, they will have finished the tavern.

Gerry's task will tell you to speak to him once the tavern is finished. He will be in the morgue, although you don't need to speak to him. He will be in the talking skull the first time you enter. You can also teleport there with the [**teleportstone**](gk2://item/teleportstone) as soon as you wake.

When you first enter the Talking Skull, Gerry will politely ask you to make a [**Barman Doll**](gk2://item/barman_doll). Do this at any tier carpenter's workbench. Once you have made the barman and placed it behind the bar, there will be a cutscene. Gerry will tell you to meet him in the Talking Skull Cellar after speaking with the barman; Gerry will not speak to you until you do.
Visit the Talking Skull page for more details on that aspect of Stranger Sins.

quests.name: Blast from the Past
text: Once you speak to Gerry and break the wall, he will send you on 17 fetch quests, each with its own cutscene. Most villagers have items, but some are buried. Gerry hopes the machine will help him remember who he is.
Gerry will ask for the following items successively:

After completing the fetch quest you then will have to dig up a a chest near the new tavern. The chest will be located north-west of the tavern, after digging up the chest you will be rewarded with 10 oro

quests.name: Get the old rusty key
text: After meeting [**Euric**](gk2://character/euric), he will ask you about the [**old rusty key**](gk2://item/old_rusty_key) and mentions about Gerry, you go to Gerry and talk to him about a bath, this being just a plan to get the key without mentioning it to Gerry. This questline requires [**A mug of beer**](gk2://item/a_mug_of_beer) and [**River sand**](gk2://item/river_sand) to obtain the [**old rusty key**](gk2://item/old_rusty_key) item to continue the quest. (Note: No other quality beer is acceptable.)
After repairing the bed in Euric's room, you get a old teeth (need to check the in game name), giving it to Gerry will reward you with some dialogues.

friendship.text: After the fourth Gula (19.5 days) and reaching 20 ♥ with Gerry, return to the morgue.

quests.name: Open the gate
text: To speak with Gunter, you must have at least 20 ♥ with [**Gerry**](gk2://character/gerry), and it must be past midnight of the fourth Gula (19.5 days). Anytime after this, when entering the morgue, a cutscene will start, and Gerry will tell you about the old Keeper's helpers and where you might find one. Going to the sacrifice zone at any point after opening it will play a cutscene where you hear moaning and investigate.

If you haven't opened the gate to the sacrifice zone or returned there after trying to get the diary, then the cutscenes you haven't seen with [**Snake**](gk2://character/snake) will play before the one with Gunter. After speaking with Snake about the dungeon, the cutscene should start immediately with additional dialogue from Snake.

If you enter the morgue after meeting the criteria for the cutscene with Gerry and anything other than the one described above starts, leave and re-enter (walking into the eastern wing of the morgue will do).

quests.name: Hit Gunter with a sword
text: Once inside his cell, he will ask you to hit him with a sword because he hasn't felt anything in years. He refuses to talk before you do this.

quests.name: Making zombies
text: He doesn't remember the specifics on how zombies are made but gives you some hints. Examining the broken cabinet next to him reveals the **Resurrection table** and [**Porter station**](gk2://item/porter_station) technologies and opening the cabinet reveals 3 × [**zombie juice**](gk2://item/zombie_juice). To discover the remaining blueprints, dig up the zombie in the rubble at the passage from the apiary to the forest near the river.
Visit the [**zombie**](gk2://item/zombie)s page for a more detailed guide on these 'willing' co-workers.

quests.name: Kebabs
text: When you first approach the camp, you notice the good smell coming from the firepit. The gypsy baron tells you it's a family recipe for [**kebabs**](gk2://item/baked_kebab) and he's willing to share it with you if you bring him 4 × [**Quality fish fillet**](gk2://item/quality_fish_fillet) (plata).

quests.name: Astrologer's request
text: Once you manage to read the old keeper's [**diary**](gk2://item/diary), you're requested by the [**astrologer**](gk2://character/astrologer) to ask the gypsy baron about Esmeralda, the mother of his long-lost child. The baron asks you to demand the release of one of his friends who has been captured by the inquisition and is awaiting trial. To do this, you need at least 60 ♥ with the [**Inquisitor**](gk2://character/inquisitor). Return to the gypsy baron and tell him, that his friend is free for 10 ♥.

As soon as you've accomplished this, the gypsy baron will tell you about Esmeralda's tragic fate and reveals that her daughter, [**Ms. Charm**](gk2://character/ms_charm), has brought disgrace to the family by losing [**her mother's family heirloom**](gk2://item/necklace) and renouncing to her gypsy background. You can then go back to the [**astrologer**](gk2://character/astrologer).

quests.name: Deliver the Letter
text: The innkeeper asks you to deliver a letter to his friend, [**Krezvold**](gk2://character/krezvold) the Blacksmith. After delivering the letter, you can return to Horadric and get [**A mug of beer**](gk2://item/a_mug_of_beer) (bronce) as reward. It can be, and is most likely expected, to be given to [**Gerry**](gk2://character/gerry) to complete one of his quests. You'll earn 10 ♥ by doing such.

quests.name: Return With Royal Stamp
text: After asking if he will purchase your [**Flesh**](gk2://item/flesh), he mentions that he would love to, but all meat must have a [**stamp**](gk2://item/stamp) to be genuine. The stamp can be obtained in two ways. The first method of obtaining a stamp involves purchasing one the royal service box (left of the Church) for 50 plata, after achieving a high enough "relationship" with it. The second method is to visit [**Snake**](gk2://character/snake) in the Cellar, and after you reach 30 ♥ with him, you will be able to ask him to give you a forged stamp. After returning to Horadric, he will teach you how to make a [**Package of meat**](gk2://item/package_of_meat) using [**Clean paper**](gk2://item/clean_paper) and [**Flesh**](gk2://item/flesh), along with the [**stamp**](gk2://item/stamp). The stamp is not consumed by crafting.

quests.name: Unlock the Kitchen Garden
text: After reading the sign in the north part of the Kitchen Garden you can ask the innkeeper about it and receive a [**Garden certificate**](gk2://item/garden_certificate) to open it up.

quests.name: Bring Beer
text: After selling [**A mug of beer**](gk2://item/a_mug_of_beer) (oro) and [**Burger**](gk2://item/burger) (oro) (both must be (oro)) at a Witch Hill burning (see [**Inquisitor**](gk2://character/inquisitor) for more details), Horadric asks you to bring him a mug of this famous beer. If you do so, you'll gain another 10 ♥ after you update the Church to Big Church. If you have 30 ♥, you can access a private area of the Dead Horse, where you can get the recipe for Mead at his desk.
(**Note:** In the current version of the game you will need 30 ♥ to gain access to the upstairs room. You need to upgrade the church to get the 30 ♥).

quests.name: Beer Snacks
text: After obtaining an [**onion**](gk2://item/onion) (bronce) at some point previously (either bought from [**Farmer**](gk2://character/farmer) or planted and harvested, must be (bronce)), [**Horadric**](gk2://character/horadric) will give you the recipe for [**Onion rings**](gk2://item/onion_rings) and [**Toasts with onions**](gk2://item/toasts_with_onions) after talking to him.

friendship.text: If you have 30 ♥, you can access a private area of the Dead Horse, where you can get the recipe for Mead at his desk.

quests.name: Come Back in a Week
text: He will ask you to be his friend and report on the the village people, then meet him again on Ira. You'll earn 10 ♥ from joining the burning.
If you don't agree to be his friend he will pay you for your services instead, but you will also have to pay him 10 silver if you want to unlock the other side of the graveyard.

quests.name: Burn the Witch
text: He asks you to bring him 20 × [**Firewood**](gk2://item/firewood) and 10 × [**Flyer**](gk2://item/flyer) in preparation for the next witch trial. Both items will earn you 10 ♥ each and give you a total of 20 ♥. You have to watch another burning for 10 ♥ and will be given access to the vineyard.

quests.name: Raising Morale
text: The Inquisitor tells you that he used to live at the vineyard with his wife and son before they died in the Great Blast. He will give you permission to use his family's vineyard on the west of Witch Hill in exchange for a promise that you bring 10 × [**Red wine**](gk2://item/red_wine) (plata) to give to the soldiers (gold wine will not work). You now have access to the [**Vine trellis**](gk2://item/vine_trellis) workbench as it will appear after you speak to him. Return to the Inquisitor for 10 ♥.

quests.name: Snack Time
text: He asks that you build a buffet tent and sell food and drink for the witch burning. Return to the Inquisitor after you built the tent for 10 ♥. Business is open!
• Stock the tent and host a burning for 2-3 more weeks to earn additional with the inquisitor, money, and faith. 5 gold-star Burgers are used in each instance of the Inquisitor's Buffet Tent event.
For more details check the buffet tent page.

quests.name: Get Rid of the Guards
text: As soon as you reach 60 ♥ with the Inquisitor he removes the guards from the hill and you earn the achievement "Night watch".

quests.name: Convincing the Crown
text: **Unlocked after three burnings.** The king is saying nonsense about "human rights" and how it's bad to just burn people without a trial. It's possible he is possessed and the Inquisitor wants you to gather proof of evil in this world. He gives you the technology required to gather [**Dark brain**](gk2://item/dark_brain), [**Dark heart**](gk2://item/dark_heart), and [**Dark intestine**](gk2://item/dark_intestine), which he will show to the king. The Quest is triggered after finishing the [**Bishop's**](gk2://character/bishop) [**Cathedral Quest**](gk2://character/bishop) he says something about fighting the Inquisition with his brother.

After delivering all three items (each increasing your by 5), a week later he comes back and says that the king doesn't take those items as proof. The Inquisitor asks you if you know of anything to use as "evidence of witchcraft. Or the undead. Or any other cult stuff." You have to choose between:
• "I could bring you a talking skull. His name is [**Gerry**](gk2://character/gerry),"
◦ The Inquisitor will decline your offer and nothing happens to [**Gerry**](gk2://character/gerry) (Unlocks "He trusted you..." Steam achievement).
• "There's a dark cult shrine, in the Cellar under the regular one," or
◦ The Inquisitor gets excited saying "That's exactly what we need! We'll catch them after the ritual."
• "I wouldn't know anything about that sort of thing."
◦ Leads to the end of conversation.
You will not be able to interact with the Inquisitor anymore - at least for the moment - after either of these conversations.

quests.name: Release the Gypsy Woman
text: The [**Gypsy Baron**](gk2://character/gypsy_baron) bids you, to ask the Inquisitor to release a friend of his. Meanwhile, you should have the 60 ♥ with the Inquisitor you need for this task. Perhaps, you'll get a good story out of this. Return to the Gypsy Baron afterwards.

quests.name: Attend the Ceremony at the Cathedral
text: After you upgrade the church to a cathedral, the [**Bishop**](gk2://character/bishop) suggests to ask the Inquisitor to join the opening service. The Inquisitor refuses and suggests [**someone else**](gk2://character/merchant).

quests.name: The Eternal Burning Coal
text: You can ask about the [**Eternal burning coal**](gk2://item/eternal_burning_coal) and he will tell you its story, but you won't get it until you've got 100 ♥ with him. That's when you finish [**Snake's questline**](gk2://character/snake).

friendship.text: When you complete some tasks and the Inquisitor has 20 ♥ with you, you can ask him for permission to expand the graveyard.
As soon as you reach 60 ♥ with the Inquisitor he removes the guards from the hill and you earn the achievement "Night watch".

quests.name: Continuing Ms. Charm's lost Necklace
text: After you have a sufficiently high enough relationship with [**Snake**](gk2://character/snake), he informs you that he ran into problems acquiring the [**Necklace**](gk2://item/necklace) for [**Ms. Charm**](gk2://character/ms_charm) and that his reputation is on the line over it. The [**Necklace**](gk2://item/necklace) apparently is of significant sentimental value to the current owner, Captain of the Mountain Fort and uncle to the King. [**Snake**](gk2://character/snake) had a misunderstanding with his contact for the Lord Commander in the past selling a salve to cure his hump that failed, and suggests you could maybe have better luck with pursuing conversation with him.

After asking the guard gate leading to the Mountain Fort about Koukol, the player can then find him at night in the dusk, West of the entrance to the Fort, roughly 1 screen away. He will remain there until dawn of the next day (all night) and retreat to the tower to the north.

After you discuss the [**Necklace**](gk2://item/necklace) with him, the player considers that the Necklace may never be found. Talk to [**Ms. Charm**](gk2://character/ms_charm) to continue the quest line.

quests.name: Kill Slimes
text: After delivering [**Horadric's**](gk2://character/horadric) letter to Krezvold and receiving 10 ♥ with Krezvold, he will ask you to kill some slimes at the back of his house. To do this he gives you a broken [**rusty sword**](gk2://item/rusty_sword), 2 × [**energy potion**](gk2://item/energy_potion), and a [**whetstone**](gk2://item/whetstone). You have to use the whetstone to repair the sword at the grindstone (next to his house) and use it to kill the slimes. Afterwards you need to bring the [**green jelly**](gk2://item/green_jelly) back to Krezvold and receive 5 × [**Simple iron parts**](gk2://item/simple_iron_parts). When this quest is completed you will have the ability to create [**green**](gk2://item/green_jelly_food) and [**red jelly**](gk2://item/red_jelly). You will also be able to trade with Krezvold.

At 10 ♥ you are able to ask him where to find metal ore. Krezvold will tell you that you can find metal ore in the swamp that's located west, across the river. You also unlock the furnace recipe, you can create [**iron ingot**](gk2://item/iron_ingot)s and you are able to gather [**iron ore**](gk2://item/iron_ore).

friendship.text: At 10 ♥ you are able to ask him where to find metal ore.

quests.name: Encargos
text: Beatrice will ask you to help her raise an army of ghouls by creating [**Emulsion of death**](gk2://item/emulsion_of_death) for her. This decision affects the fate of the refugee camp.

quests.name: Fish Dishes
text: Ask him how to prepare fish and he will tell you recipes of some fish dishes.

quests.name: Fishing Rod
text: Bring the Lighthouse Keeper 6 × [**Moth**](gk2://item/moth) in exchange for a [**simple fishing rod**](gk2://item/simple_fishing_rod).

quests.name: Necronomicon
text: The [**Astrologer**](gk2://character/astrologer) tells you, that he gave the [**Necronomicon**](gk2://item/necronomicon) to his friend, the Lighthouse Keeper. If you ask him about it, he'll give it to you for 5 × [**Maggot**](gk2://item/maggot).

quests.name: First task
text: Teodoro first asks you to build :
• a Water well I (12 × [**A piece of stone**](gk2://item/a_piece_of_stone), 2 × [**Simple iron parts**](gk2://item/simple_iron_parts), 3 × **Refugee Happiness** Refugee happiness)
• a Residential tent (4 × [**Wooden stick**](gk2://item/wooden_stick), 2 × [**Silk**](gk2://item/silk), 2 × **Refugee Happiness**) for the camp.
Second task For the next task, he asks yout to build :
• a second Residential tent (4 × [**Wooden stick**](gk2://item/wooden_stick), 2 × [**Silk**](gk2://item/silk), 5 × **Refugee Happiness**)
• a Fence supplies for garden (24 × [**Flitch**](gk2://item/flitch), 12 × [**Wood billet**](gk2://item/wood_billet), 2 × **Refugee Happiness**).
◦ Once the garden is built, up to 4 beds can be built to grow veggies for 6 × [**Flitch**](gk2://item/flitch), 8 × [**Peat**](gk2://item/peat), 2 × **Refugee Happiness** each.
◦ Optionally, you can offer to build the Cooking table for 6 × [**Flitch**](gk2://item/flitch), 12 × [**Nails**](gk2://item/nails), 6 × **Refugee Happiness**.
◦ Once built and after talking to Cook, the Cooking Table II becomes available for 12 × [**Wooden plank**](gk2://item/wooden_plank), 18 × [**Nails**](gk2://item/nails), 8 × **Refugee Happiness**.

◦ Finally, Cook wants something sweet for her kitchen, leading to the building of up to 3 beehives for 4 × [**Flitch**](gk2://item/flitch), 10 × [**Bee**](gk2://item/bee), 2 × **Refugee Happiness** each.

◦ Once the tent and garden are built, he will ask for a Water well II (8 × [**Flitch**](gk2://item/flitch), 5 × [**Simple iron parts**](gk2://item/simple_iron_parts), 2 × **Refugee Happiness**) and a total of 7 people in the camp.

• Once these are completed, Teodoro will give you 50 plata, [**Witchers eye**](gk2://item/witcher_s_eye), 15 × [**porcelain pitcher**](gk2://item/porcelain_pitcher), and [**Jewelry**](gk2://item/jewelry).
After you meet [**Lady Beatrice**](gk2://character/lady_beatrice) and inform Teodoro about her, Teodoro will ask you to build an additional Residential tent, Storehouse II, and Campfire II.

Once the aforementioned is completed, Teodoro asks you to build one more tent and Teodoro's Workplace. He also wants there to be a total of 11 people in the camp. Afterwards, he rewards you with a [**Universal Bag**](gk2://item/universal_bag), the recipe for Universal Bags, 3 × [**A carved piece of marble**](gk2://item/a_carved_piece_of_marble) (oro), [**Gold ingot**](gk2://item/gold_ingot), and [**Book**](gk2://item/book) (oro).

After [**Lady Beatrice**](gk2://character/lady_beatrice)'s guards confront you in your house, Teodoro asks you to build Stakes around the camp (48 Flitch, 24 wooden sticks, 11 Happiness). He then asks you to build a Rack of Swords (5 Steel swords, 4 Flitch, 12 Happiness), and finally the Observation Tower (12 Beams, 18 Flitch, 13 Happiness). He rewards you with [**Great book (g)**](gk2://item/techbook), [**Great book (b)**](gk2://item/techbook), [**Great book (r)**](gk2://item/techbook), [**Big universal bag**](gk2://item/big_universal_bag), and the recipe for Big universal bags.

name: Merchant
title: Merchant
location: Trade office south of the tavern

quests.name: Buy or Farm
text: After talking to [**Horadric**](gk2://character/horadric) about a vegetable garden south of the keeper's house he will tell you that it is abandoned and that he sold it to the merchant. He asks you to speak to the merchant first, but you are able to do it anyway after using the [**Garden certificate**](gk2://item/garden_certificate).
After meeting the merchant he tells you that you can use the land if you are able to successfully grow vegetables.
First he demands, 10 oro.
If you refuse once, 5 oro.

If you refuse twice, you will be able to ask him for a barter. If you don't accept it though you'll have to buy the garden for 10 oro and make it nice again. After an apology, he'll trade with you again, and lower the price to a final 1 oro. You'll still be able to work the garden without paying the money, but you need to pay to advance the questline. Paying him any amount of money skips the first harvest quest.

If you accept the barter, he gives you a quest to bring him your first harvest of 12 × [**Carrot**](gk2://item/carrot), 12 × [**Cabbage**](gk2://item/cabbage), and 12 × [**Beet**](gk2://item/beet) to get a [**Story**](gk2://item/story) (bronce).

quests.name: Hiccup Cure
text: The merchant is suffering from hiccups. After trying to scare the hiccups out of him, he gives you a quest to find [**Hiccup grass**](gk2://item/hiccup_grass) growing in the swamp, west of the church across the stone bridge which you have to repair. Return to the merchant for 10 ♥ and a [**Story**](gk2://item/story) (bronce).

quests.name: No Taste
text: After you bring him some [**Hiccup grass**](gk2://item/hiccup_grass) it cures his hiccups but also leaves him unable to taste anything due to a curse. He requests that you speak to [**Clotho**](gk2://character/clotho) about a cure.

After some back-and-forth about professional courtesy to the other witch who cursed him, [**Clotho**](gk2://character/clotho) relents and tells you the recipe for her cure: [**Salt**](gk2://item/salt) and [**health solution**](gk2://item/health_solution). These two ingredients used together will create [**spices**](gk2://item/spices). It is possible to create spices without talking to her first.
Bring the spices to the merchant for another 10 ♥. You can not give him the spices without first talking to [**Clotho**](gk2://character/clotho).

quests.name: Royal Dinner
text: Next task is making 5x (oro) [**Dinner**](gk2://item/dinner) (oro) for him to present them before the king.

quests.name: After 60
text: You need to complete the two tasks related to the trade office (getting enough fame and selling 7 crates), that should give you at least 70 ♥ to unlock the next step. You ask him how the royal dinner was, and he said it was great, and that even though now they got some support from the royal council as a whole, the head of the council needs some more convincing. More specifically, [**Ms. Charm**](gk2://character/ms_charm)'s convincing.

quests.name: Promoting your business
text: You want to try and use [**Ms. Charm**](gk2://character/ms_charm) to make your veggie-selling business grow. You need at least 40 ♥ with her for that, and you need to make her a piece of [**jewelry**](gk2://item/jewelry). After doing this, besides getting **fame** for the trade office, she will start selling [**jewelry**](gk2://item/jewelry) and [**perfume**](gk2://item/perfume).

quests.name: Big Ceremony
text: The merchant tells you that all went well, but he wants to attend a big ceremony as keeper of the king's kitchen and needs your help for that. After the [**Inquisitor**](gk2://character/inquisitor) turned you down, you can ask the merchant to join your feast in the cathedral. He agrees and hands you an [**Accepted invitation**](gk2://item/accepted_invitation) to show to the [**bishop**](gk2://character/bishop).

quests.name: Salty Fork
text: Ask him for the [**Salty fork**](gk2://item/salty_fork). He'll only give it to you if you reached 100 ♥ with him.

friendship.text: You need at least 40 ♥ with her for that, and you need to make her a piece of [**jewelry**](gk2://item/jewelry).
He'll only give it to you if you reached 100 ♥ with him.

quests.name: Fixing the Mill
text: Doing [**Ms. Charm**](gk2://character/ms_charm)'s quest line will eventually lead you to being asked to fix the broken mill. You have to talk to the miller first. Then seek help at the [**astrologer**](gk2://character/astrologer) to figure out the [**paper with calculations**](gk2://item/paper_with_calculations). Then return to the mill to complete the project.

After fixing the mill, go back to the [**farmer**](gk2://character/farmer) and talk to him. You will get Alisa's Papers and from now on, you will be able to mill your 10 × [**Wheat**](gk2://item/wheat) into 15 × [**flour**](gk2://item/flour) for free.

quests.name: Visit Clotho
text: After you brought back [**Ms. Charm**](gk2://character/ms_charm) the bad news about her [**necklace**](gk2://item/necklace), she wants Miss Chain's [**perfume**](gk2://item/perfume). In order to get it from her, you have to deliver a [**Basket of food**](gk2://item/basket_of_food) to her sister [**Clotho**](gk2://character/clotho), and bring back 12 × [**Frog**](gk2://item/frog) as ingredients for creating more [**perfume**](gk2://item/perfume). For this you'll recieve a total of 20 ♥ and you can get the [**perfume**](gk2://item/perfume) from her.

name: Mountain Fort Guard
title: Guard access to the Mountain fort

quests.name: Prove Your Worth
text: She does not want to speak to you. To get her to acknowledgment you need to "Be Confident" requiring 5 × **faith** and you will receive 10 ♥. Afterwards she says there might be something to your dirty and ragged charm and asks for a compliment.

quests.name: Fake Coins For Snake
text: You must speak to [**Horadric**](gk2://character/horadric) and start the [**Return with Royal Stamp**](gk2://character/horadric) quest for this dialog with Ms. Charm to be available.

You think Ms. Charm might be able to help you make a deal with [**Snake**](gk2://character/snake) but cannot think of what kind of business someone like you would have with him. She tells you to throw these fake [**coins**](gk2://item/coins) to [**Snake's**](gk2://character/snake) face and return to tell her how he reacted. When you give them to him he asks if you knew it was a joke and wants to know if you are her new lover. No matter how you answer he criticizes you for falling for her charms. You receive 10 ♥ after completing the quest.

quests.name: The Hunchback of the War Camp
text: Ms. Charm wants you to ask [**Snake**](gk2://character/snake) to find her [**necklace**](gk2://item/necklace). You will need 30 ♥ with [**Snake**](gk2://character/snake) in order to proceed with the quest. He sends you to seek out the mountain fort for this. The [**guard**](gk2://character/guards) there tells you that you can meet a servant a bit west of the entrance at night. This servant is [**Koukol**](gk2://character/koukol), a faithful servant to the Lord Commander's family, and he tells you the [**necklace**](gk2://item/necklace) is impossible for you to get. When you get back with that bad news you'll receive 10 ♥ from her.

quests.name: Perfume
text: After you deliver the bad news, she tells you, now she really wants [**Miss Chains'**](gk2://character/miss_chain) [**perfume**](gk2://item/perfume). You've got to accompish another task in order to get the [**perfume**](gk2://item/perfume) from [**Miss Chains'**](gk2://character/miss_chain) and deliver it to Ms. Charm for 10 ♥.

quests.name: Promote Business
text: Now, you should have 40 ♥ with her. Then you could ask her to promote your vegetable business (see [**the Merchant's quest**](gk2://character/merchant) for more details). She wants to be given a [**Jewelry**](gk2://item/jewelry) in order to help you. After you bring her one, she starts to sell and buy [**Jewelry**](gk2://item/jewelry) and [**perfume**](gk2://item/perfume).

quests.name: Ms. Charm's Show
text: Once you give her the [**perfume**](gk2://item/perfume), she requests [**story**](gk2://item/story) (oro) for her show. Note that giving her one will grant you enough to continue with the [**Astrologer's**](gk2://character/astrologer) quest line. You'll earn 10 ♥ from this.
The next step is to try and convince Alisa's father (the local [**farmer**](gk2://character/farmer)) to allow her to accompany her to the King's palace in town.

quests.name: Ms. Charm's Father
text: To advance the [**Astrologer's**](gk2://character/astrologer) quest, you have to talk to her about her father. You need 50 ♥, just to be told that she hates him.

quests.name: Fixing the Windmill
text: The [**farmer**](gk2://character/farmer) doesn't want Alisa going to town, but her [**brother**](gk2://character/farmer_s_son) comes forward saying that if you manage to fix his [**uncle's**](gk2://character/miller) windmill, his father would surely be so happy that he would allow her to go. You need to go to the [**miller**](gk2://character/miller) and he will give you the instructions to repair the windmill, but all in Latin, with one page missing. You need to go ask the [**Astrologer**](gk2://character/astrologer) for help. You need to have at least 60 ♥ with him to restore the [**Paper with calculations**](gk2://item/paper_with_calculations). Together with 5 × [**complex iron parts**](gk2://item/complex_iron_parts) and 6 × [**wooden plank**](gk2://item/wooden_plank), you'll get the mill up and running once again (you'll be able to mill your wheat here for free from now on). Speak to the [**farmer**](gk2://character/farmer) again and he will grant his daughter permission to go to town with Ms. Charm.

quests.name: Correcting the Papers
text: Ms. Charm gets very happy when you bring her Alisa's paper for 10 more , but she botches it when trying to forge her age to make her two years older. She wants now an aristocrat to sign the papers, so you need to buy [**Aristocrat papers**](gk2://item/aristocrat_papers) through the Royal services (this requires 100 ♥ with the Royal services and 12 oro). Show her your Aristocrat papers for 10 more .

quests.name: New Love Song
text: Now, she wants you to bring her the greatest love song ever. When you ask [**Vagner**](gk2://character/vagner) to help you with this, he wants you to prepare a fly agaric [**infusion**](gk2://item/infusion) for his inspiration to write one. After handing the concoction over to him, return after some days and he will be missing from the Tavern. Go search for him near the Mountain Fort Cliffs and you'll get the lyrics that you can hand over to Ms. Charm for 10 ♥ and the achievement "Ideal song".

quests.name: Save the Poet
text: As you report to her, that [**Vagner**](gk2://character/vagner) was arrested by the guards, she wants you to rescue him from the Mountain Fort. You promise to help and think that the [**Astrologer**](gk2://character/astrologer) might be able to help you in this case.

After some tasks, you manage to accomplish for the [**Astrologer**](gk2://character/astrologer), Ms. Charm joins you for the rescue mission. In the end, you'll get the [**necklace**](gk2://item/necklace) from her and end up with a total of 100 ♥.

friendship.text: You need 50 ♥, just to be told that she hates him.
You need to have at least 60 ♥ with him to restore the [**Paper with calculations**](gk2://item/paper_with_calculations).

She wants now an aristocrat to sign the papers, so you need to buy [**Aristocrat papers**](gk2://item/aristocrat_papers) through the Royal services (this requires 100 ♥ with the Royal services and 12 oro).

quests.name: Bring Smiler a Berry Pie
text: After the cutscene where [**Euric**](gk2://character/euric) asks you [**Seed oil**](gk2://item/seed_oil), you can talk with Smiler who will ask a [**Berry pie**](gk2://item/berry_pie) to give you some information.

quests.name: Healing from Pride
text: After unlocking Healer Enthusiast in the Spiritualism tech tree and building the appropriate extensions, speak to Smiler. He tells you that you need to find someone with a strong sense of pride in order to complete the healing session. You are unable to think of such a person, but you determine that [**Horadric**](gk2://character/horadric) likely knows, so speak to him at the Dead Horse. He tells you that [**Bishop**](gk2://character/bishop) is likely who you are looking for. Speak to Euric. The two of you determine that Bishop is unlikely to just agree outright and will require persuasion, and that the healing session may require Bishop to express his sin - that of Pride. In order to do so, you speak to Vagner, who gives you an Ode to Bishop. Recite the Ode to Bishop next Orgullo (this requires a [**Sin Shard**](gk2://item/sin_shard)). You will receive a charged Sin Shard, which you take to Euric for his first healing session. The next day, Euric has left a note for you in his room.

quests.name: Healing from Wrath & Gluttony
text: After unlocking Experienced healer on the Spirituality tech tree, talk to Euric again and you will begin to pursue the Wrath and Gluttony charged Sin Shards.
**Wrath**

Discuss Wrath with Euric and you will identify [**Inquisitor**](gk2://character/inquisitor) as the next target. You and Euric decide to present him with the ashes of a dead witch, which you then obtain from [**Clotho**](gk2://character/clotho) in exchange for two [**Honey**](gk2://item/honey). Give the Unusual ash and a Sin Shard to Inquisitor. Turns out all those witch burnings Inquisitor demanded allegedly helped witches do more evil things. You will receive a Wrath charged Sin Shard.
**Gluttony**

Discuss Gluttony with Euric and you will identify [**Merchant**](gk2://character/merchant) as the next target. Euric tells you to get to him through food. You talk to Clotho, who gives you a recipe for a sauce to give to Merchant. Make the Mysterious food sauce at the Church workbench (requires 1x [**Seed oil**](gk2://item/seed_oil), 2x [**Chicken egg**](gk2://item/chicken_egg), and 1x [**Salt**](gk2://item/salt)) and take it to Merchant with one Sin Shard. He gives you a charged Sin Shard.
Take both the Wrath and Gluttony Sin Shards back to Euric for his cutscene. Find another note in his room, then speak with Horadric to get a cutscene.

quests.name: Send Smiler through the Soul portal
text: After certain events have passed, Smiler will ask you to let him depart to the afterlife.

quests.name: Prove You Are the Graveyard Keeper
text: • At night, find Snake near the closed gate underneath the Sweet Home.
• Snake does not believe you are the graveyard keeper, he has no interest in you and you annoy him.
• Return to him with 5 × **Faith**.

quests.name: Unlocking the Sacrifice Zone and Dungeon
text: • Speak to the [**Astrologer**](gk2://character/astrologer) and accept his quest to find the [**Keepers journal**](gk2://item/keepers_journal). He will give you the [**Keepers key**](gk2://item/keepers_key).
• Give Snake the unusable [**Keepers key**](gk2://item/keepers_key), to receive the [**Instructions for key**](gk2://item/instructions_for_key).

• Study the [**Keepers key**](gk2://item/keepers_key) at a [**Study table**](gk2://item/study_table) with the [**Instructions for key**](gk2://item/instructions_for_key) in your inventory to get an [**Active key**](gk2://item/active_key).
• Give the [**Active key**](gk2://item/active_key) to Snake.
• Rewards:
◦ +10 ♥ with Snake.
◦ Snake's schedule changes, so he will now only show up on Envidia instead of every night.
◦ The gate to the Sacrifice Zone is unlocked.
◦ The player gains access to the Dungeon.
◦ The player gains access to [**Gunter**](gk2://character/gunter).

quests.name: The Necklace
text: Requires: 30 ♥ with Snake.
• Select the dialogue option asking about [**Ms. Charm's**](gk2://character/ms_charm) [**necklace**](gk2://item/necklace).
◦ Reward: +10 ♥ with Snake.
• He tells the player that [**Koukol**](gk2://character/koukol) has it now.

quests.name: Help Snake with the Ritual
text: After you hand him the [**active key**](gk2://item/active_key), a cutscene plays where you die trying to get the [**Keepers journal**](gk2://item/keepers_journal), but just return to your bed. You discover that you are functionally immortal.
• Bring Snake 5 × [**Bloody nails**](gk2://item/bloody_nails). These are dropped by Iron Maidens on levels 4+ of the Dungeon.
◦ Reward: +10 ♥ with Snake.
• Bring Snake a [**Bucket of blood**](gk2://item/bucket_of_blood).
◦ Dungeon level 5 will always have a chest containing it.

◦ [**Bucket of blood**](gk2://item/bucket_of_blood) can be crafted at a church workbench using 10 × [**Blood**](gk2://item/blood). At some point in the Game of Crone DLC, you can deliver any leftover [**Bucket of blood**](gk2://item/bucket_of_blood) to a related NPC.
• Reward: +10 ♥ with Snake.
Return to Snake. He will attempt a ritual, fail, and then ask the player to help him find a [**Necronomicon**](gk2://item/necronomicon).
• Collect the **Restoration tools** from Snake, if you have not done so already.
◦ You will need to deliver them to the [**Astrologer**](gk2://character/astrologer) to gain enough Reputation to unlock the dialogue option about the [**Necronomicon**](gk2://item/necronomicon).

• Speak with the [**Astrologer**](gk2://character/astrologer) about the [**Necronomicon**](gk2://item/necronomicon); he'll say that he gave it to the [**Lighthouse Keeper**](gk2://character/lighthouse_keeper).
• Speak with the [**Lighthouse Keeper**](gk2://character/lighthouse_keeper) and give him 5 × [**Maggot**](gk2://item/maggot) in exchange for the Necronomicon.
• Bring the [**Necronomicon**](gk2://item/necronomicon) to Snake to gain +10 ♥.
Once he is given the [**Necronomicon**](gk2://item/necronomicon), Snake will ask the player to decorate the Sacrifice Zone for the ritual.
• Build decorations in the Sacrifice Zone to increase its .
◦ At the blueprint table, craft all of the available blueprints.
◦ Once the two blood fountains are built, make sure they are filled (a "craft" option appears while standing near them).
• Speak with Snake when the Sacrifice Zone has reached 20 .
◦ Rewards: +10 ♥.

• Bring Snake a [**Damask sword with gem**](gk2://item/damask_sword_with_gem). The player can purchase one from [**Koukol**](gk2://character/koukol) at night, or craft it themselves if they have unlocked the required technology.
◦ Rewards: +10 ♥.
• Observe the "ritual" cutscene.
• After the cutscene, return to the Sacrifice Zone and speak to Snake.

quests.name: Ambush the Vampire Hunter
text: • At any time after completing the ritual for Snake, go to sleep, and then wake up.
• Observe a cutscene where Snake is at your bedside when you wake. Snake asks the player to help them set a trap for a vampire hunter.

• Deliver [**Wooden plank**](gk2://item/wooden_plank) to Snake, who will be located just south of the vineyard on Witch Hill. If the player takes the path from the main road, he can be seen near the giant round boulder.
◦ Rewards: +10 ♥
• Observe a long cutscene where Snake and the player wait, and then kill the hunter with a boulder.
◦ Time will skip forward, but the player will be returned to the weekday and time they began the cutscene at its conclusion.

• Mine the Boulder to obtain the medallion that unlocks Dungeon levels 11-15, plus 6 × [**a piece of stone**](gk2://item/a_piece_of_stone) and a [**corpse**](gk2://item/corpse) with 7 x and 3 x (including two Dark organs - but no fat). The corpse will also yield only one sin shard when its soul is cleaned.

quests.name: The Golden Apple
text: • When you ask Snake about the last task, he will bid you to get the [**Golden apple**](gk2://item/golden_apple) from the dungeon.
◦ Rewards: 10 ♥ by this.
◦ When you get it and give it to him he will ask if you would like to lick it. If you say yes you will get 100 blue.
• Can be found at the end of the last floor (level 15) of the dungeon.
• You can also buy it from [**Clotho**](gk2://character/clotho) for 10 oro.
• Or get it by a [**Woodcutter**](gk2://character/woodcutter) quest.

quests.name: The Dark Heart
text: After receiving the [**Golden apple**](gk2://item/golden_apple) Snake will remember the last ingredient of his ritual, a [**Dark heart**](gk2://item/dark_heart). Bring him one, and he will leave to summon his followers. [**Gerry**](gk2://character/gerry) shows up and hints, that the results of the ritual will be hilarious and not at all what Snake expects.

He returns with his followers and proceeds to summon his father, who turns out to be none other than the [**Inquisitor**](gk2://character/inquisitor) himself! After being dramatically reunited, they both give you their treasured possessions. You receive Snake's [**Endless notebook**](gk2://item/endless_notebook) and the Inquisitor's [**Eternal burning coal**](gk2://item/eternal_burning_coal). (Steam achievement "A father and a son" unlocked)

friendship.text: At 20 ♥ Snake will offer you a [**Town pass**](gk2://item/town_pass) which can be used to get past the guards to the south of the village and access the town.
At 30 ♥ Snake will give you a [**stamp**](gk2://item/stamp) free of charge.
At 40 ♥ Snake will give you **Restoration tools** for the questline of the [**Astrologer**](gk2://character/astrologer).
At 60 ♥ Snake will help you to get the parts for the laser on the town.

name: Tanner
title: Bags and bag techs
notes: Comercia con: Bags and bag techs.

quests.name: Encargos
text: The Tanner had to sell her shop and her workstation at The Town to repay her son's debt. She asks for you to build a workplace for her at the refugee camp, so she can make a few revenues here as well, because her belongings at The Town did not cover the debt entirely. Finishing this quest unlocks trading tier I.

After you get the workplace ready for her, she will need a few more ingredients. She will ask you to build an animal farm for her. Fence supplies requires 24 [**Flitch**](gk2://item/flitch),12 [**Wood Billet**](gk2://item/wood_billet) and 12 Refugee Happiness.Finishing this quest unlocks trading tier II.

For the animal farm to be functional, she'll ask you to settle a cow and hens. (You can get the cow from [**Rosa**](gk2://character/rosa) for 1 oro and the hens from the [**Fresh egg basket**](gk2://character/fresh_egg_basket) for 50 plata) Finishing this quest unlocks trading tier III and she'll give you **Recipe alchemists bag**, **Recipe farmers bag**, **Recipe fishermans bag**.

quests.name: Encargos
text: First, she asks you to make a few new tools (5 × [**Iron chisel**](gk2://item/iron_chisel), 10 × [**Wood wedge**](gk2://item/wood_wedge)) for her because she left them in the Town. Finishing this quest unlocks trading tier I.
Next, she'll ask you to build a workplace for her at the camp. Finishing this quest unlocks trading tier II.

To enable her to make better quality gravestones, she asks you to bring 5 × [**steel chisel**](gk2://item/steel_chisel) (oro). Finishing this quest unlocks trading tier III and she'll give you **Recipe advanced gravestones**, **Recipe advanced gravestones II**.

quests.name: Ink and Paper for the Poet
text: After first having met [**Ms. Charm**](gk2://character/ms_charm), Vagner asks you, what she said to you, and tells you that he wants to impress her by writing poetry. However, he lacks the resources to write anything. However, you earn 5 ♥ from that dialogue.

The poet needs 10 × [**Clean paper**](gk2://item/clean_paper). You can either make this at the church workbench in the alchemy lab from [**pigskin paper**](gk2://item/pigskin_paper) or in the workyard using the paper press. Alternatively, you can purchase [**clean paper**](gk2://item/clean_paper) from the [**Astrologer**](gk2://character/astrologer) but it will take several weeks to collect enough considering how little he has in stock. Return to Vagner for 10 ♥.

The poet needs [**Ink**](gk2://item/ink). It can be made at the church workbench in the Alchemy Lab from [**black paint**](gk2://item/black_paint), [**glass cones**](gk2://item/conical_flasks) and [**water**](gk2://item/water). [**Black paint**](gk2://item/black_paint) is produced at the [**alchemy workbench**](gk2://item/alchemy_workbench_tier_i). See alchemy for more information. Alternatively [**ink**](gk2://item/ink) can be purchased from the [**Astrologer**](gk2://character/astrologer). Return to Vagner for 10 ♥.

quests.name: Liquid Inspiration
text: Vagner tells you that he will trade you a good story [**story**](gk2://item/story) (plata) for [**Red wine**](gk2://item/red_wine) (plata). After trading he will say "Good wine is my friend! Here's a story.". You can either produce the [**wine**](gk2://item/red_wine) yourself or buy it from [**Horadric**](gk2://character/horadric) among his tier II wares. This quest is repeatable. After doing the exchange six times, this quest is no longer available. He claims that you have taken all his best stories, leaving him unable to impress [**Ms. Charm**](gk2://character/ms_charm).

quests.name: Write a song to Ms. Charm
text: [**Ms. Charm**](gk2://character/ms_charm) asks you to write her a song. Since you are no poet, you can't do it yourself. You know a poet though, so you ask Vagner if he is willing to help his love. He immediately agrees, but he wants to write not just any song - the best song he ever wrote. To do that he needs a special kind of creative boost. So it happens that he knows the recipe - he heard about it in the university. And now you do too [**Booze**](gk2://item/booze) and 3 × [**Red mushroom**](gk2://item/red_mushroom), mixed at a distillery, should do the trick. Brew this wonderful [**mix**](gk2://item/infusion) and bring it to Vagner. He will chug it, smile widely and ask to wait. Come visit him the next day.

quests.name: Unexpected side-effects
text: Upon visiting the tavern the next day (you need to sleep in your bed!), you will find a note from Vagner. In it, he asks you to come to the cliffs east of the mountain fort at night (he will be to the right of the [**Gypsy Baron**](gk2://character/gypsy_baron); nowhere near [**Dig**](gk2://character/dig) or the Lighthouse). When you do, Vagner will emerge from hiding. The special 'creative booster' had a side effect - he has an appearance of a monster rather than a man.

You try to calm the poor soul, but at the same moment patrolling guards stumble upon the two of you. They immediately proceed to capture Vagner, despite your protest that this is no monster. In the end they take him to the mountain fort.
After all this, you end up with song lyrics in your pockets, which you can hand over to [**Ms. Charm**](gk2://character/ms_charm) to continue her quest.

quests.name: Rescue mission
text: [**Ms. Charm**](gk2://character/ms_charm) was so enticed by the song, that she fell in love with the poet and wants him to be rescued. You win the [**astrologer**](gk2://character/astrologer) for that case and manage to organize an expedition to the mountain fort. You succeed in rescuing Vagner.
[**Ms. Charm**](gk2://character/ms_charm) even manages to heal the poet, by kissing him.
If all of Vagner's quests are completed, he will leave for the northern fort. For the Game of Crone DLC, he can be contacted via the Royal Services box at the church.

quests.name: A Nicer Axe
text: Woodcutter asks you to bring him an iron axe. If you talk to him again you say that you have a nicer axe and give him [**Axe I**](gk2://item/axe_i), he will reward you with the Lasagna and Pasta recipes.

quests.name: The Golden Apple
text: After you finishing the [**Bishop**](gk2://character/bishop) quest "Hold the Ceremony", you have to talk to [**Bishop**](gk2://character/bishop) one week later to wrap it up. Then go to the Dead Horse which will trigger this quest.

Woodcutter meets you inside The Dead Horse and talks about a golden apple that he's willing to trade. To get one [**golden apple**](gk2://item/golden_apple) you must trade him: x24 [**Roof tile**](gk2://item/roof_tile) and x4 [**curtains**](gk2://item/curtains).

quests.name: Get rid of that guy!
text: After your first night in your bed, Yorick appears and asks you to exhume the [**corpse**](gk2://item/corpse) in the lower right corner of the graveyard and toss it into the river, claiming that they are a jerk and should be evicted from the graveyard.
**Note:** You can choose any corpse, as long as you throw it into the river.

After you dig up a corpse and throw it into the river, [**Gerry**](gk2://character/gerry) appears and scolds you for having done so. He tells you about where to burn corpses. This is better than throwing them into the river, as you get a [**burial certificate**](gk2://item/burial_certificate) for cremating them.
The following night, the ghost appears again and teaches you something about how to improve your de valoración del cementerio.
